releaseVersion.policy: Marketing version is shared across platforms. Every submitted binary must monotonically increase the platform build number/version code; marketing version changes are explicit release decisions.

complianceInventory.reason: No public, versioned privacy-policy route/URL is frozen in the repository.
The authenticated mobile My flow has no account-deletion entry or request flow.
No public web deletion-request resource is frozen for Google Play metadata.
Generated app and third-party SDK required-reason API declarations must be audited before submission metadata is frozen.
Data Safety answers must be derived from the final production data flow and included SDKs.
Store copy must be reviewed to avoid unsupported diagnostic or medical claims.

passMeans: Public app identity and platform build numbers are explicit.
Generated native projects match the frozen identity, permission and minimum-platform contracts.
Android can produce a release AAB without production upload signing.
The Android release AAB resolves target API 36 and requests 16 KB page alignment, with packaged native ELF LOAD segments aligned to at least 16 KB.
iOS can produce an unsigned Release archive, separating compile/archive viability from distribution signing.
Known store compliance and external-authority blockers are explicit and fail-visible.
passDoesNotMean: App Store or Google Play submission readiness.
Privacy policy/Data Safety/App Privacy metadata completion.
